string.text: Geiger ticks and the HUD radiation bar work only with a charged geiger counter in your inventory. No radiation grain (optional film grain below). The inventory tooltip hides the exact dose (MCM option).

Hidden: no radiation icon on the HUD. Shown, mSv with geiger: the icon changes color with exposure; the mSv value above it appears only while you carry a charged geiger counter. Shown, no mSv: icon without the value. Only with geiger: no icon without a charged geiger counter; with one, icon and mSv value. Only with geiger, no mSv: icon only with a charged geiger counter, never the value.

Radiation tooltip in the inventory (UI Rework G.A.M.M.A. Style). Always hidden: the current dose (mSv) is removed; the radiation removal rate of your gear stays. Shown with geiger: "???" without a charged geiger counter, the real dose with one.
Geiger clicks for your own irradiation (dose in the body).
Geiger clicks for surrounding radiation while you stand in a radiation field.
Only with geiger in detector slot
Clicks only when the charged geiger counter is in the detector slot, not just anywhere in the inventory. Affects sound only.

Only with DAR Dosimeter Enhanced installed. Overrides the internal/external checkboxes: environment mode = environment clicks, contamination mode = body clicks, self-scan mode = environment clicks (body clicks only during the self-scan). The dosimeter mode is saved with the game.
Radiation film grain on screen. Strength follows your own dose and the radiation around you. Off by default. Has no visible effect with Grain RGB & Psi Color Effects Remover installed.
